blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag said that his Christmas wishlist includes the arrest of wanted high-profile personalities such as Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, businessman Charlie “Atong” Ang, and former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Elizaldy Co. Matibag also wishes for the apprehension of former Bureau of Corrections chief Gerald Bantag and former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque. “I have a long list of Christmas wishes: Mahuli na si Bato, mahuli si Atong Ang, si General Bantag, si Harry Roque, umuwi na, ‘di ba?
